name: Tarot Cards
overview: Scripture clearly condemns practices associated with witchcraft, enchantments, and seeking guidance from familiar spirits, as seen in commands to avoid wizards and those who use enchantments (Leviticus 19:26, 19:31, 20:6). The example of Pharaoh's magicians imitating signs but failing to alter God's sovereign will (Exodus 7:10, 7:22) further illustrates the futility and opposition of occult practices. Therefore, engaging with tarot cards, which fall under such occult practices, is forbidden as it turns one away from reliance on the Lord and invites defilement and judgment as warned in Exodus 22:18.
